title: The Local — Independent band & songwriter showcase booking
summary: Nashville independent band and songwriter room actively accepting EPKs, live performance links, and local draw history through its talent buyer. Ideal anchor room for building Nashville draw or kicking off a Southeast weekend run.
recommendedAction: Convert to Lead and send EPK, live video link, and 3 target weekend dates to the talent buyer.

payload.recommendedAngle: Pitch a co-bill with a local Nashville opener and include live video + draw numbers.

title: One World Brewing (West Asheville) — Regional touring band slots
summary: West Asheville and downtown taprooms regularly book touring regional bands across indie, funk, jazz, and Americana via their dedicated booking request portal. Strong I-40 routing bridge between Knoxville/Nashville and Carolinas dates.
recommendedAction: Convert to Lead and submit regional routing dates + live set clips via the venue booking form.

payload.recommendedAngle: Anchor a Thursday/Friday routing stop with merch table + local cross-promo.

title: Asheville Music Hall — Regional headliner & tour support routing
summary: Premier independent mid-sized room in downtown Asheville coordinating touring support bills and regional headliners directly through its booking desk. High-leverage support slot opportunity for expanding Western NC fan base.
recommendedAction: Convert to Lead, inspect upcoming calendar bills, and pitch direct support on genre-matched touring stops.

payload.recommendedAngle: Target open direct-support slots on announced regional bills 6-10 weeks out.

title: Smith's Olde Bar — Atlanta market-entry independent bills
summary: Historic Atlanta independent venue coordinating breaking-band and regional bills in the Atlanta Room and Music Room. Reliable Southeast routing anchor for bands establishing Atlanta draw and press visibility.
recommendedAction: Convert to Lead and propose a 3-band Atlanta bill with two local draw partners.

payload.recommendedAngle: Pitch a curated 3-band bill pairing out-of-market routing with two established Atlanta acts.
